title: 第19章 师父白苍真人第20章 一刀师兄上门算计
content_zh:
“弟子拜见师父。”
“你来了。”
“不知道师父寻找弟子所为何事。”
许君白战战兢兢站着，不敢抬头看。
第三次见师父，最近，师父召见自己越发频繁，上一次才多久。
历练任务完成之后，许君白以为自己会被遗忘，没想到。
“抬起头来，难道为师让你如此畏惧吗？”
“是。”
许君白抬起头，表情控制得很好，和上一次一样。
许君白察觉到了师父的一抹隐晦的杀意，似乎是针对他的，又似乎不是。
“两年了，你还是搬气一重天。”
言语中，带着浓郁的不满。
还有一点嫌弃。
“弟子有愧于师父，还请师父莫要为了弟子动怒。”
许君白早已经准备好了说辞，就是为了应对这一刻，他确定了，师父看不出他的修为。
《长春诀》的收敛能力很强，起码，他不需要担心修为被看穿。
搬气一重天的修为，一直都是这个修为，没有被看穿过。
许君白不想让师父看穿，师父是无法看穿，他的那颗心也放下了。
“哼，看来你清楚得很。”
白苍真人起身，走到了许君白面前。

低头，冷冷看了一眼许君白，那嫌弃的眼神，多么要命。
“为师这一次有一个任务交给你。”
许君白一听，赶紧拒绝：“师父，弟子修为低弱，恐怕无法完成师父的任务，还请师父收回成命。”
“砰。”
许君白被击飞了。
“噗。”
鲜血，喷出。
他脸色煞白，不敢再吭声。
“为师给你的任务，轮不到你拒绝。”
“只此一次！”
冰冷的目光扫了一眼许君白，那眼神，随时都会杀了他。
许君白低头，不敢露出任何表情。
白苍真人回归了他的位置，端坐上方，居高临下。
许君白压力更甚，那股无形的压力和气势，让他无法抬起头。
这是师父的压制，不想看到他的脸。
“为师需要一块太阴鬼石。”
“一年之内，给为师找到。”
content_en:
"Disciple pays homage to Master."
"You're here."
"I don't know why Master is looking for his disciple."
Xu Junbai stood tremblingly, not daring to look up.
This is my third time to see Master. Recently, Master has summoned me more and more frequently. The last time was only a short time ago.
After completing the training mission, Xu Junbai thought he would be forgotten, but he didn't expect it.
"Look up, does being a teacher scare you so much?"
"Yes."
Xu Junbai raised his head, his expression well controlled, the same as last time.
Xu Junbai noticed a vague murderous intention from his master, which seemed to be aimed at him, but it seemed not.
"It's been two years and you're still so angry."
There was strong dissatisfaction in his words.
There's also a bit of disgust.
"This disciple is ashamed of his master, and he also asks his master not to be angry because of his disciples."
Xu Junbai had already prepared his words, just to deal with this moment. He was sure that the master could not see his cultivation level.
"Changchun Jue" has a very strong restraint ability. At least, he doesn't need to worry about his cultivation being seen through.
The cultivation level of Qi Yiyi Layer has always been this cultivation level, and has never been seen through.
Xu Junbai didn't want the master to see through, but the master couldn't see through, and his heart was relieved.
"Hmph, it seems you know very well."
Master Bai Cang stood up and walked to Xu Junbai.
He lowered his head and glanced at Xu Junbai coldly. That look of disgust was so terrifying.
"My teacher has a task for you this time."
When Xu Junbai heard this, he quickly refused: "Master, my disciple's cultivation is low and I'm afraid I won't be able to complete the master's mission. Please take back my life."
"Bang."
Xu Junbai was knocked away.
"Pfft."
Blood spurts out.
His face turned pale and he didn't dare to say anything anymore.
"It's not your turn to refuse the mission my master has given you."
"Just this once!"
He glanced at Xu Junbai with cold eyes, that look could kill him at any time.
Xu Junbai lowered his head, not daring to show any expression.
Master Bai Cang returned to his position, sitting upright and condescending.
Xu Junbai was even more stressed. The invisible pressure and momentum made it impossible for him to raise his head.
This is Master's suppression, he doesn't want to see his face.
"I need a Taiyin ghost stone as my teacher."
"I will find it for you within a year."
